overview: Brick-built, minifig-proportioned character inspired by the reference: a blond-haired hero in an all-white outfit holding a blue lightsaber. Build as a small display figure with simple blocky anatomy and a standout weapon.

subassemblies.name: Feet & Lower Legs
subassemblies.description: Two chunky white feet with short shins above them; add a hint of tan/gold striping on the lower legs to echo the printed leg detail.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of the image (both feet on the ground; striping appears on the lower legs above the feet).

subassemblies.name: Hips / Belt Block
subassemblies.description: A 2–3 brick-tall waist section in white with a dark red belt band; include a small front ‘buckle/pouch’ bump using a dark red or reddish-brown element.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-lower torso area, just above the legs (the red belt line).

subassemblies.name: Torso / Robe Chest
subassemblies.description: White torso block with a subtle V-shaped ‘wrap’ suggestion using a few dark/gray accents (dark bluish gray/black plates or tiles) while keeping it mostly white and clean.
subassemblies.image_location: Center of the figure (white robe body).

subassemblies.name: Arms (2) with Two-Hand Grip Pose
subassemblies.description: Two white arms built as simple stacked slopes/plates; angle them forward so both meet at the hilt. Use small hinges/clips if available; otherwise, build stepped arms that converge at center.
subassemblies.image_location: Mid-right of the image where both hands hold the hilt in front of the chest.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber Hilt
subassemblies.description: Cylindrical-looking hilt using light bluish gray/dark bluish gray round/clip/stacked elements; keep it 1–2 studs thick and about 5–7 studs long so it reads as a handle.
subassemblies.image_location: In front of the torso, between the arms (silver/gray handle).

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber Blade
subassemblies.description: Trans-light-blue/clear stack approximating a glowing blade (use trans-clear + trans elements you have; cap the tip with a small trans piece). Aim for a long, straight, vertical-ish blade.
subassemblies.image_location: Upper-right of the image extending upward (bright blue blade).

subassemblies.name: Head + Hair Cap
subassemblies.description: A compact head block in light tan/medium nougat tones with a simple face suggestion (dark tiles/plates for eyes/brow). Add a blond ‘hair’ mass on top using tan/yellow/bright-light-yellow slopes/curves layered forward.
subassemblies.image_location: Top-left of the figure (face) and top (blond hair).

subassemblies.name: Back/Neck Support (internal)
subassemblies.description: Small internal spine of light/dark bluish gray to tie head, torso, and arm assembly together and keep the forward-held saber stable.
subassemblies.image_location: Inside the torso/back (not visible in the image).

subassemblies.name: Display Base (optional)
subassemblies.description: Simple dark bluish gray/black plate base to stabilize the stance and prevent tipping from the extended blade and forward arms.
subassemblies.image_location: Under the feet (not shown, but implied for stability).

notes: Primary color blocking: mostly White for outfit; Dark Red for belt; Tan/Yellow for hair; Light/Dark Bluish Gray for hilt; Trans-clear/trans elements for blade.
Keep the figure blocky and sturdy: prioritize stud-to-stud connections over fragile side-only detailing.
If arm posing is hard with available joints, build both arms as a single ‘forearm bridge’ subassembly attached to the torso, with the hilt captured between layered plates.
Use your abundant white plates/bricks (3004/3005/3024/3023/3710 etc.) for clean robe surfaces; add minimal dark accents to suggest the wrap lines.
Blade can be a trans-clear core with a few trans-yellow/trans-orange accents avoided; keep it mostly clear/blue-toned to match the reference glow.
